create_BatchNormalization: create a sparse convolutional batch normalization layer with configurable planes, eps, momentum, and leakiness
create_BatchNormReLU: create a batch normalization layer followed by ReLU activation for sparse convolutional networks
create_BatchNormLeakyReLU: create a batch normalization layer followed by LeakyReLU activation with configurable leakiness parameter
create_MeanOnlyBNLeakyReLU: create a mean-only batch normalization layer with affine bias and LeakyReLU activation for sparse tensors
create_SparseGroupNorm: create a sparse-aware group normalization layer wrapping torch.nn.GroupNorm for sparse convolutional tensors
